{{Quote|My people are not Jedi or Sith. But our existence has always been tied to the Force. We are aware of its presence.|Urai Fen to Tyber Zann when arriving on Dathomir|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
The '''Talortai''' were a mysterious [[Species/Legends|species]] with both avian and reptilian qualities that had rapid regeneration and lacked aging, with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|ability]] to distinguish between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] sides of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], and was a large part of this species' life; however, for unknown reasons, many did not become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. 

==Biology and appearance==
Talortai were a scaled, bipedal race with an upper jaw similar in appearance to a beak. They were immune to the effects of aging, and at least one known member [[Urai Fen]] demonstrated the ability to rapidly regenerate injuries. Additionally, Urai Fen mentioned that his Force-sensitivity was something he did not like to speak of.
